profile.summary: Queridomundo Creative is a graphic design studio in Oakland, California. It offers design, illustration and copywriting for print and online use, including flyers, event posters, infographics, publications and exhibition displays. Its clients are mainly nonprofits and consultants.

The 'mainly nonprofits and consultants' client line rests only on portfolio mentions (City Slicker Farms, a consultant) and is slightly loose, but it is not a material claim.
